cases.prompt: Create a polished mobile-first task list screen for a generic household productivity app. Include a compact header, Today and Upcoming sections, checkbox controls, assignee initials, due-time labels, priority indication, and one obvious add-task action. The viewport is 390x844. Return one complete self-contained HTML document with inline CSS only, no JavaScript, no external assets, and no explanation.

Create a polished mobile-first shared shopping checklist for a generic household app. Include a list title, progress summary, grouped grocery items, quantity text, purchased and unpurchased states, and a fast add-item control. The viewport is 390x844. Return one complete self-contained HTML document with inline CSS only, no JavaScript, no external assets, and no explanation.

Create a calm responsive household dashboard for a generic coordination app. Include navigation, a greeting, task summary, shopping summary, upcoming events, and recent activity. It must work at 390x844 and 1280x900 without horizontal scrolling. Return one complete self-contained HTML document with inline CSS only, no JavaScript, no external assets, and no explanation.
